## About

Sohail Gidwani is an AI/ML engineer and full-stack developer currently pursuing a Master of Science in Computer Science at the University of Southern California (Viterbi School of Engineering), expected May 2027. He builds production AI systems (RAG pipelines, multi-modal deep learning, LLM-powered applications) and pairs them with clean, user-facing frontends. Previously a Full-Stack Software Developer at IIFL Finance Ltd and Senior Software Engineer at Insaito, Inc.

Sohail Gidwani is an Agentic AI/ML Engineer and M.S. Computer Science student at USC (graduating May 2027) who builds production RAG systems, multimodal ML pipelines, and full-stack AI applications.

Full-time AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Agentic AI Engineer, and Full-Stack AI Engineer roles. Open to remote, hybrid, or relocation; based in Los Angeles, CA.

### What are Sohail's strongest proof points?

- Built AI agent-builder infrastructure at Insaito using open-source LLMs and reusable OAuth/MCP foundations designed for a catalog of 100+ third-party apps.
- Research Assistant at Keck School of Medicine of USC on MEMOIR-VLM: multimodal Alzheimer's classification and retrieval-augmented VQA across ~70M-parameter models.
- Built Portage, an autonomous Flask → FastAPI migration agent that plans target architecture (creating new modules, not just rewriting files), with checkpoint-resume durability, network-off sandbox verification, and 61.9% strict green across 21 autonomous runs (7 pinned repos, K=3).
- Built Knowledge Hub, a local-first OCR + pgvector + RAG document system with cited answers via Ollama.

## Current Role

Research Assistant at Keck School of Medicine of USC, working on multimodal deep learning for Alzheimer's disease classification and VQA using neuroimaging and clinical data across ~70M parameter models.

## Research

- MEMOIR-VLM (Multimodal VLM for Alzheimer's Disease Classification and VQA, manuscript submitted): Keck USC, 2,363 ADNI subjects, 0.707 balanced accuracy on 3-class diagnosis, missing-modality cross-attention fusion, retrieval-augmented VQA benchmarking Mistral 7B vs Gemma 4 26B vs MedGemma 1.5 4B (https://sohailgidwani.app/research/memoir-vlm-alzheimers-vqa)
- CoT Faithfulness Analysis: USC CSCI-544 NLP study: 4 experiments (SCR, CFR, SBH) probing chain-of-thought faithfulness in Llama 3.2 3B and Qwen 2.5 7B across GSM8K and ARC-Challenge; ~15K queries via Ollama (https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/cot-faithfulness)

## Projects

- Portage: Autonomous code-migration agent (Flask → FastAPI): plans target architecture with artifact-producing plans, LangGraph + Postgres checkpointing, network-off Docker sandbox verification, bounded recovery, CLI + MCP interfaces, 61.9% strict green over 21 autonomous runs (7 pinned repos, K=3) (https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/portage). Technical Deep Dive: https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/portage/deep-dive
- Knowledge Hub: Document management with OCR, semantic search (pgvector), and RAG Q&A via Ollama (https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/knowledge-hub). Technical Deep Dive: https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/knowledge-hub/deep-dive
- Image Captioning: VGG-16 feature extraction with LSTM and Transformer caption decoders, deployed via Streamlit (https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/image-captioning)
- ScribeGlobe: Medium-style blogging platform on Cloudflare Workers with Hono + React (https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/scribeglobe)
- Tech Updates: AI-powered news aggregator using Azure OpenAI and Qdrant for semantic deduplication (https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/tech-updates)
